<!--
  Hand-maintained page. Only the block between the COMPARISON-DATA markers near the end is
  generated, by code/build_comparison_data.py, from:
    output/direct comparison.ods          the words: factor, Slocum, Seaglider, comments
    content/data/comparison-tags.csv      which glider has the edge, and which topics a factor
                                          belongs to (topic ids are the TOPICS list below)
  Change either, then run:  python3 code/build_comparison_data.py

```{=html}
<style>
  #dcp {
    --surface: #FFFFFF; --surface-2: #F1F6F7; --line: #DAE3E5; --line-strong: #BCCBCE;
    --ink: #1F2C31; --ink-2: #536268; --ink-3: #78888E;
    --accent: #2780E3; --accent-ink: #1B62B0; --accent-soft: #E3EEFB;
    --sl: #2a78d6; --sg: #eb6834; --mix: #78888E;
    --sl-soft: #EAF2FC; --sg-soft: #FDEEE7;
    --mark: #FFF1B8;
    --sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    max-width: 1250px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); line-height: 1.5;
  }
  body.quarto-dark #dcp, :root[data-bs-theme="dark"] #dcp {
    --surface: #212121; --surface-2: #2A2A2A; --line: #3A3A3A; --line-strong: #4E4E4E;
    --ink: #F2F2F2; --ink-2: #BFC6C8; --ink-3: #939A9D;
    --accent: #75AADB; --accent-ink: #9CC6EC; --accent-soft: #23323F;
    --sl: #3987e5; --sg: #d95926; --mix: #939A9D;
    --sl-soft: #1D2836; --sg-soft: #33231C;
    --mark: #5A4A12;
  }
  #dcp * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  #dcp .lede { color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 80ch; }

  /* ---- focus bar ---- */
  #dcp .bar {
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 14px 16px 0; margin: 16px 0 14px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(31,44,49,.07);
  }
  @media (min-width: 900px) { #dcp .bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; } }
  #dcp .k { font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 700; }
  #dcp .topics { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin: 7px 0 10px; }
  #dcp button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; }
  #dcp button:focus-visible, #dcp input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
  #dcp .chip {
    font-size: 13.5px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2);
    transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s;
  }
  #dcp .chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); }
  #dcp .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 700; }
  #dcp .chip .n { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-left: 5px; font-weight: 400; }
  #dcp .chip.clear { border-style: dashed; }
  #dcp .tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 18px; align-items: center; padding-bottom: 10px; }
  #dcp input[type="search"] {
    font: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; padding: 5px 10px; width: 220px; max-width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink);
  }
  #dcp .edges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
  #dcp .edgebtn {
    font-size: 12.5px; padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  }
  #dcp .edgebtn[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--ink-3); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; background: var(--surface-2); }
  #dcp .sw { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block; }
  #dcp .sw.slocum { background: var(--sl); }
  #dcp .sw.seaglider { background: var(--sg); }
  #dcp .sw.depends { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sl) 0 3px, var(--sg) 3px 6px); }

  #dcp .summary { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 9px 0 10px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2);
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 18px; align-items: center; }
  #dcp .summary b { color: var(--ink); }
  #dcp .tally { display: flex; height: 8px; width: 180px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-2); gap: 2px; }
  #dcp .tally span { display: block; height: 100%; transition: flex-grow .3s; }
  #dcp .tally .slocum { background: var(--sl); }
  #dcp .tally .seaglider { background: var(--sg); }
  #dcp .tally .depends { background: var(--mix); opacity: .55; }
  #dcp .summary .caveat { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12px; }

  #dcp .colhead { display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--cols); gap: 0 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 7px 0 8px; }
  #dcp .colhead div { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  #dcp { --cols: minmax(170px, 0.8fr) 1.3fr 1.3fr; }

  /* ---- rows ---- */
  #dcp .group { margin: 22px 0 6px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; }
  #dcp .group h2 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; border: 0; padding: 0; }
  #dcp .group .gn { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-3); }
  #dcp .group button { font-size: 12.5px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--accent-ink); padding: 0; }
  #dcp .group button:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  #dcp .row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--cols); gap: 8px 14px; align-items: start;
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; transition: opacity .25s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
  }
  #dcp .row.hit { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent) inset; }
  #dcp .row.dim { opacity: .5; }
  #dcp .row.dim:hover { opacity: 1; }
  #dcp .row[hidden], #dcp .group[hidden] { display: none; }
  #dcp .fac h3 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 2px; line-height: 1.3; }
  #dcp .fac .sec { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3); display: none; }
  #dcp.focused .fac .sec { display: block; }
  #dcp .verdict { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #dcp .tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-top: 7px; }
  #dcp .tag { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 5px; }
  #dcp .tag.on { color: var(--accent-ink); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 700; }
  #dcp .cell { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 9px; border-left: 3px solid transparent; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  #dcp .cell .who { display: none; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-3); margin-bottom: 2px; }
  #dcp .cell.win { color: var(--ink); }
  #dcp .cell.sl.win { background: var(--sl-soft); border-left-color: var(--sl); }
  #dcp .cell.sg.win { background: var(--sg-soft); border-left-color: var(--sg); }
  #dcp .row.depends .cell { border-left-color: var(--line-strong); }
  #dcp .note { grid-column: 2 / -1; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 10px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  #dcp .note .nk { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-3); margin-right: 6px; }
  #dcp .note.on { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent) inset; }
  #dcp .note.on .nk { color: var(--accent-ink); }
  #dcp mark { background: var(--mark); color: inherit; padding: 0 1px; border-radius: 2px; }
  #dcp a { color: var(--accent-ink); }
  #dcp .empty { color: var(--ink-3); padding: 18px 2px; }
  #dcp .foot { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 18px; }

  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    #dcp .colhead { display: none; }
    #dcp .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    #dcp .note { grid-column: 1; }
    #dcp .cell .who { display: block; }
    #dcp .cell { border-left-color: var(--line); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #dcp * { transition: none !important; } }
</style>

<div id="dcp">

  <p class="lede">A side-by-side look at the gliders we fly, from pilots' notes. Pick what
  matters for your mission and the factors that bear on it move to the top. Pilot notes that speak
  to your pick are highlighted, and everything else stays on the page, dimmed, below them. The shaded cell in each row is the glider with the edge; rows
  marked trade-off are the ones where the answer depends on the mission.</p>

  <div class="bar">
    <div class="k" id="topics_lbl">What matters for your mission?</div>
    <div class="topics" id="topics" role="group" aria-labelledby="topics_lbl"></div>
    <div class="tools">
      <input type="search" id="q" placeholder="Search factors and notes" aria-label="Search factors and notes">
      <div class="edges" role="group" aria-label="Show only rows where">
        <span class="k">Show</span>
        <button class="edgebtn" data-edge="slocum" aria-pressed="false"><i class="sw slocum"></i>Slocum edge</button>
        <button class="edgebtn" data-edge="seaglider" aria-pressed="false"><i class="sw seaglider"></i>Seaglider edge</button>
        <button class="edgebtn" data-edge="depends" aria-pressed="false"><i class="sw depends"></i>Trade-off</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="summary" id="summary" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <div class="colhead" aria-hidden="true">
      <div>Factor</div>
      <div><i class="sw slocum"></i>Slocum</div>
      <div><i class="sw seaglider"></i>Seaglider</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="list"></div>
  <p class="foot" id="foot"></p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var D = window.COMPARISON, root = document.getElementById("dcp");
  if (!D || !root) return;

  // Topic ids are what content/data/comparison-tags.csv uses in its `topics` column.
  var TOPICS = [
    { id: "cost",      label: "Operating cost" },
    { id: "endurance", label: "Endurance & energy" },
    { id: "shallow",   label: "Shallow / coastal" },
    { id: "deep",      label: "Deep / open ocean" },
    { id: "risk",      label: "Failure points & safety nets" },
    { id: "piloting",  label: "Piloting & learning curve" },
    { id: "science",   label: "Science payload & acoustics" },
    { id: "fieldops",  label: "Deployment & field logistics" }
  ];
  var TOPIC = {}; TOPICS.forEach(function (t) { TOPIC[t.id] = t; });
  var VERDICT = { slocum: "Edge: Slocum", seaglider: "Edge: Seaglider", depends: "Trade-off" };

  var state = { focus: [], edges: [], q: "" };
  var rows = D.rows.map(function (r, i) { r.i = i; return r; });

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; });
  }
  // Escape, mark search hits, and turn bare URLs into links (never marking inside a URL).
  function rich(s) {
    var out = "", re = /https?:\/\/[^\s<>()]+[^\s<>().,;:]/g, last = 0, m;
    while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
      out += hilite(s.slice(last, m.index)) +
        '<a href="' + esc(m[0]) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(m[0].replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")) + "</a>";
      last = m.index + m[0].length;
    }
    return (out + hilite(s.slice(last))).replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
  }
  function hilite(s) {
    if (!state.q) return esc(s);
    var q = state.q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
    return s.split(new RegExp("(" + q + ")", "ig")).map(function (p, i) {
      return i % 2 ? "<mark>" + esc(p) + "</mark>" : esc(p);
    }).join("");
  }

  // ---- static parts ----
  var topicsEl = document.getElementById("topics");
  topicsEl.innerHTML = TOPICS.map(function (t) {
    var n = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.topics.indexOf(t.id) >= 0; }).length;
    return '<button class="chip" data-topic="' + t.id + '" aria-pressed="false">' + esc(t.label) + '<span class="n">' + n + "</span></button>";
  }).join("") + '<button class="chip clear" id="clear" hidden>Clear</button>';

  // One element per factor, built once and moved around, so the reorder can animate.
  var list = document.getElementById("list");
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    var el = document.createElement("article");
    el.className = "row " + (r.edge || "none");
    r.el = el;
  });
  function paint(r) {
    var sl = r.edge === "slocum", sg = r.edge === "seaglider";
    var noteHit = (r.note_topics || []).some(function (t) { return state.focus.indexOf(t) >= 0; });
    r.el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="fac"><h3>' + hilite(r.factor) + "</h3>" +
        '<div class="sec">' + esc(r.section) + "</div>" +
        (r.edge ? '<div class="verdict"><i class="sw ' + r.edge + '"></i>' + VERDICT[r.edge] + "</div>" : "") +
        '<div class="tags">' + r.topics.map(function (t) {
          return '<span class="tag' + (state.focus.indexOf(t) >= 0 ? " on" : "") + '">' + esc(TOPIC[t] ? TOPIC[t].label : t) + "</span>";
        }).join("") + "</div></div>" +
      '<div class="cell sl' + (sl ? " win" : "") + '"><span class="who">Slocum</span>' + rich(r.slocum) + "</div>" +
      '<div class="cell sg' + (sg ? " win" : "") + '"><span class="who">Seaglider</span>' + rich(r.seaglider) + "</div>" +
      (r.note ? '<div class="note' + (noteHit ? " on" : "") + '"><span class="nk">Note</span>' + rich(r.note) + "</div>" : "");
  }

  function group(title, n, extra) {
    var g = document.createElement("div");
    g.className = "group";
    g.innerHTML = "<h2>" + esc(title) + '</h2><span class="gn">' + n + (n === 1 ? " factor" : " factors") + "</span>" + (extra || "");
    return g;
  }

  var restOpen = true;

  function render() {
    var q = state.q.toLowerCase();
    var visible = rows.filter(function (r) {
      if (state.edges.length && state.edges.indexOf(r.edge) < 0) return false;
      if (q && [r.factor, r.slocum, r.seaglider, r.note, r.section].join(" ").toLowerCase().indexOf(q) < 0) return false;
      return true;
    });
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      r.score = r.topics.filter(function (t) { return state.focus.indexOf(t) >= 0; }).length;
      paint(r);
    });

    // FLIP: remember where every row was, rebuild the order, then slide from old to new.
    var before = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) { if (r.el.isConnected) before[r.i] = r.el.getBoundingClientRect().top; });

    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    root.classList.toggle("focused", state.focus.length > 0);
    if (!state.focus.length) {
      var sec = null, inSec = [];
      var flush = function () {
        if (!inSec.length) return;
        frag.appendChild(group(sec, inSec.length));
        inSec.forEach(function (r) { r.el.classList.remove("hit", "dim"); r.el.hidden = false; frag.appendChild(r.el); });
      };
      visible.forEach(function (r) { if (r.section !== sec) { flush(); sec = r.section; inSec = []; } inSec.push(r); });
      flush();
    } else {
      var hits = visible.filter(function (r) { return r.score > 0; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score || a.i - b.i; });
      var rest = visible.filter(function (r) { return r.score === 0; });
      var names = state.focus.map(function (t) { return TOPIC[t].label; }).join(" + ");
      frag.appendChild(group("Bears on " + names, hits.length));
      hits.forEach(function (r) { r.el.classList.add("hit"); r.el.classList.remove("dim"); r.el.hidden = false; frag.appendChild(r.el); });
      if (rest.length) {
        frag.appendChild(group("Everything else", rest.length,
          '<button id="rest_tog" aria-expanded="' + restOpen + '">' + (restOpen ? "Hide" : "Show") + "</button>"));
        rest.forEach(function (r) { r.el.classList.remove("hit"); r.el.classList.add("dim"); r.el.hidden = !restOpen; frag.appendChild(r.el); });
      }
    }
    list.innerHTML = "";
    list.appendChild(frag);
    if (!visible.length) list.innerHTML = '<p class="empty">No factor matches. Clear the search or the filters above.</p>';

    var reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (!reduce) rows.forEach(function (r) {
      if (!(r.i in before) || r.el.hidden || !r.el.isConnected) return;
      var dy = before[r.i] - r.el.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      if (Math.abs(dy) < 2) return;
      r.el.style.transition = "none";
      r.el.style.transform = "translateY(" + dy + "px)";
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        r.el.style.transition = "transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), opacity .25s";
        r.el.style.transform = "";
      });
    });

    summarize(visible);
    syncControls();
    var h = state.focus.length ? "#focus=" + state.focus.join(",") : " ";
    try { history.replaceState(null, "", h === " " ? location.pathname + location.search : h); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function summarize(visible) {
    var set = state.focus.length ? visible.filter(function (r) { return r.score > 0; }) : visible;
    var c = { slocum: 0, seaglider: 0, depends: 0 };
    set.forEach(function (r) { if (c[r.edge] != null) c[r.edge]++; });
    var lead = state.focus.length
      ? "<span><b>" + set.length + "</b> of " + rows.length + " factors bear on what you picked.</span>"
      : "<span>All <b>" + set.length + "</b> factors" + (set.length < rows.length ? " shown" : "") + ".</span>";
    document.getElementById("summary").innerHTML = set.length ? lead +
      '<span class="tally" role="img" aria-label="Slocum edge ' + c.slocum + ", Seaglider edge " + c.seaglider + ", trade-off " + c.depends + '">' +
        '<span class="slocum" style="flex-grow:' + c.slocum + '"></span>' +
        '<span class="seaglider" style="flex-grow:' + c.seaglider + '"></span>' +
        '<span class="depends" style="flex-grow:' + c.depends + '"></span></span>' +
      "<span>Slocum edge <b>" + c.slocum + "</b> · Seaglider edge <b>" + c.seaglider + "</b> · Trade-off <b>" + c.depends + "</b></span>" +
      '<span class="caveat">A count, not a score: one factor can outweigh the rest for your mission.</span>'
      : lead;
  }

  function syncControls() {
    topicsEl.querySelectorAll("[data-topic]").forEach(function (b) {
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", state.focus.indexOf(b.dataset.topic) >= 0);
    });
    document.getElementById("clear").hidden = !state.focus.length;
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-edge]").forEach(function (b) {
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", state.edges.indexOf(b.dataset.edge) >= 0);
    });
  }

  function toggle(arr, v) { var i = arr.indexOf(v); if (i >= 0) arr.splice(i, 1); else arr.push(v); }

  topicsEl.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
    if (b.id === "clear") state.focus = []; else toggle(state.focus, b.dataset.topic);
    render();
  });
  root.querySelector(".edges").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("[data-edge]"); if (!b) return;
    toggle(state.edges, b.dataset.edge); render();
  });
  var qt;
  document.getElementById("q").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    clearTimeout(qt); qt = setTimeout(function () { state.q = e.target.value.trim(); render(); }, 120);
  });
  list.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.id === "rest_tog") { restOpen = !restOpen; render(); }
  });

  var m = /focus=([\w,]+)/.exec(location.hash);
  if (m) state.focus = m[1].split(",").filter(function (t) { return TOPIC[t]; });
  document.getElementById("foot").textContent = "Source: " + D.source + ", built " + D.built + ".";
  render();
})();
</script>
```
